author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Today a very obvious fly hacker. In the previous hours, no staff members have been online and it was really depressing. Avicus needs more timezone-balanced mods. Anyways:

Name of player being reported: Exactly_RighT
Rule broken: Fly > Hacking
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jUAgSRYDbsM
Anything else you would like to add? It's self explaining. He actually fell into the void, but suddenly appears at the wool room. He didn't die and he only could have done this using a fly hack.

Also, I believe it's just one of those unlimited alts hacker, because he just joined Avicus (for the first time on that account) and just started hacking.

Greetings,
-Atdit
